_note: Between runs: power-ups bought in town with gold (no account levels). price doubles per purchase; max per power-up (default upgrade_max). Shop and stash settings below. mastery_xp: total class XP for mastery levels 1-10 (every run adds its XP to its class, death included). Mastery decides which skills a class knows (the MUD's base-class unlock levels) and how well.

skip.name: Skip
skip.desc: Pass on a boon offer and take nothing.

reroll.name: Reroll
reroll.desc: Replace all three boons on offer with new ones.

banish.name: Banish
banish.desc: Remove one offered boon from the pool for the rest of the run; a new one takes its place.

provisions.name: Provisions
provisions.desc: Start every run with one more healing potion.

fortune.name: Fortune
fortune.desc: Better odds of rare, epic and legendary boons.
